customer_invoices_percent_in_range.name: customer_invoices_percent_in_range
customer_invoices_percent_in_range.value:
percent_complete_ten_thou is null
        or (percent_complete_ten_thou >= 0 and percent_complete_ten_thou <= 10000)

holdback_ledger_one_event_per_row.name: holdback_ledger_one_event_per_row
holdback_ledger_one_event_per_row.value:
case entry_kind
          when 'accrual' then released_cents = 0
          when 'release' then accrued_cents = 0 and released_cents >= 0
        end

expenses_kind_shape.name: expenses_kind_shape
expenses_kind_shape.value:
case kind
          when 'mileage' then
            vendor_id is null
            and receipt_file_id is null
            and payment_method is null
            and vendor_tax_number_captured is null
            and tax_total_cents = 0
            and is_billable = false
            and distance_milli is not null
            and rate_per_km_ten_thou is not null
          when 'purchase' then
            distance_milli is null
            and rate_per_km_ten_thou is null
        end

schedule_tasks_actual_order.name: schedule_tasks_actual_order
schedule_tasks_actual_order.value: actual_end is null or (actual_start is not null and actual_end >= actual_start)

schedule_tasks_no_self_dependency.name: schedule_tasks_no_self_dependency
schedule_tasks_no_self_dependency.value: predecessor_task_id is null or predecessor_task_id <> id

schedule_tasks_lag_needs_predecessor.name: schedule_tasks_lag_needs_predecessor
schedule_tasks_lag_needs_predecessor.value: predecessor_task_id is not null or lag_days = 0

schedule_tasks_percent_range.name: schedule_tasks_percent_range
schedule_tasks_percent_range.value:
percent_complete_ten_thou is null
        or (percent_complete_ten_thou >= 0 and percent_complete_ten_thou <= 10000)

schedule_template_tasks_no_self_dependen.name: schedule_template_tasks_no_self_dependency
schedule_template_tasks_no_self_dependen.value: predecessor_task_id is null or predecessor_task_id <> id

schedule_template_tasks_lag_needs_predec.name: schedule_template_tasks_lag_needs_predecessor
schedule_template_tasks_lag_needs_predec.value: predecessor_task_id is not null or lag_days = 0

schedule_template_tasks_duration_source_.name: schedule_template_tasks_duration_source_columns
schedule_template_tasks_duration_source_.value:
(duration_source = 'area'
          and duration_area_per_day_milli is not null and duration_area_per_day_milli > 0
          and duration_days_per_unit is null)
        or (duration_source in ('washrooms', 'kitchens', 'bedrooms')
          and duration_days_per_unit is not null and duration_days_per_unit > 0
          and duration_area_per_day_milli is null)
        or (duration_source = 'none'
          and duration_area_per_day_milli is null
          and duration_days_per_unit is null)

assignments_one_live_vendor_per_task.name: assignments_one_live_vendor_per_task
assignments_one_live_vendor_per_task.where: vendor_id is not null and removed_at is null and record_status = 'active'

assignments_one_live_user_per_task.name: assignments_one_live_user_per_task
assignments_one_live_user_per_task.where: user_id is not null and removed_at is null and record_status = 'active'

assignments_not_confirmed_and_declined.name: assignments_not_confirmed_and_declined
assignments_not_confirmed_and_declined.value: confirmed_at is null or declined_at is null

assignments_removal_detail_needs_removal.name: assignments_removal_detail_needs_removal
assignments_removal_detail_needs_removal.value: removed_at is not null or (removed_by is null and removal_reason is null)
